Hi Jane,

Blood Typed, the first Val Jenkins mystery, follows a Halifax Post books columnist who would rather be on the crime beat, and I enjoyed how it pokes fun at the literary world in Nova Scotia.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short trailer or a few reels for Blood Typed is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production, from concept to finished files you can share with readers and booksellers. It is entirely optional and sits alongside the feature rather than being part of it.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Blood Typed best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
